description: Read Google’s live first results page for one search in one country: ranked results, features, AI Overview citations, People Also Ask and related searches. Changes nothing and uses no credits; each store has a daily limit.

language.description: Language code, e.g. "en". Defaults to the store’s language.

location.description: Target country, e.g. "United States". Ask the merchant which countries they sell to if unknown.

store.description: The connected store to use. Omit when only one is connected.
